description: Golden parity cases for the read-only lib/podman queries (#252): each case runs its lib/podman function with a podman stand-in (stub) that answers the scripted calls; arg, every podman argument and the scripted stdout and stderr are printf %b text. stdout, status and calls (what the function printed, returned and the podman calls it made) are recorded from bash by test/oneshot-podman-parity.bats.
stub:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# The podman stand-in of test/fixtures/podman-parity.json: logs each call to ${PODMAN_PARITY_DIR}/calls (the arguments,
# each ended by \x1f, one call a line), then answers with the response scripted for exactly those arguments: the
# response-<n>.stdout and .stderr files hold printf %b text and .status the exit status
dir="${PODMAN_PARITY_DIR:?}"
{
    printf '%s\x1f' "$@"
    printf '\n'
} >> "${dir}/calls"
call="${dir}/call.$$"
printf '%s\0' "$@" > "${call}"
for args in "${dir}"/response-*.args; do
    [ -f "${args}" ] || continue
    cmp -s "${args}" "${call}" || continue
    rm -f "${call}"
    response="${args%.args}"
    text=""
    IFS= read -r -d '' text < "${response}.stdout"
    printf '%b' "${text}"
    text=""
    IFS= read -r -d '' text < "${response}.stderr"
    printf '%b' "${text}" >&2
    exit "$(cat "${response}.status")"
done
rm -f "${call}"
printf 'podman parity stub: no response scripted for: %s\n' "$*" >&2
exit 125
